# Beautiful Blinds & Shades

> Custom blinds, shades and plantation shutters, plus blind and shade repair and cleaning, for homes in Fort Wayne, Indiana and the surrounding towns of Northeast Indiana. Every project starts with a free in-home consultation: samples are brought to the home, windows are measured, and treatments are made to fit and professionally installed. Phone: (260) 222-6467.

Service area: Fort Wayne and Allen County, Indiana, including Angola, Auburn, Bluffton, Columbia City, Grabill, Harlan, Hoagland, Huntertown, Kendallville, Leo-Cedarville, Monroeville, New Haven, Syracuse, Warsaw and Woodburn, plus Hicksville, Ohio.

Pricing is not published. Quotes are given during the free in-home consultation.

- [Home](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/): Overview of custom blinds, shades and shutters in Fort Wayne

- [Contact and free consultation](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/contact): Book a free in-home consultation or call (260) 222-6467
- [Service area](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/location/beautiful-blinds-and-shades-service-area): Towns served across Northeast Indiana

## Services

- [Blind and shade repair](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/services/blind-shade-repair): Repair of broken cords, stuck shades, bent slats and motorized shades
- [Blind and shade cleaning](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/services/blind-and-shade-cleaning): Professional cleaning of blinds and shades
- [Custom window treatments](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/services/window-treatments): All treatment types, measured and installed
- [Outdoor shades](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/services/outdoor-shades): Patio and porch shades for sun, privacy and comfort

## Blinds

- [Custom blinds](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/products/blinds): Wood, faux wood, aluminum and vertical blinds
- [Mini blinds](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/custom-blinds-fort-wayne-indiana/custom-mini-blinds-in-fort-wayne-indiana)

- [Panel track blinds](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/custom-blinds-fort-wayne-indiana/custom-panel-track-blinds-fort-wayne-indiana): For sliding doors and large openings

- [Plantation shutters](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/products/plantation-shutters): Interior shutters in wood and composite
- [Wood plantation shutters](https://www.beautifulblindsandshades.com/custom-interior-plantation-shutters-fort-wayne-indiana/custom-wood-plantation-shutters-in-fort-wayne-indiana)
